description: Implementation of the ClientSocketHandle class managing socket lifecycle, including initialization, priority setting, resetting, and error handling within the net namespace.

classes.name: ClientSocketHandle
classes.description: Manages a network socket's lifecycle, including initialization, priority, resetting, and error state management within the net namespace.

methods.name: ClientSocketHandle::Init
methods.description: Initializes the socket handle by requesting a socket from the pool with specified parameters.

methods.name: ClientSocketHandle::SetPriority
methods.description: Sets the priority of the socket request if the socket is not yet initialized.

methods.name: ClientSocketHandle::Reset
methods.description: Resets the socket handle, releasing resources and resetting error states.

methods.name: ClientSocketHandle::ResetAndCloseSocket
methods.description: Closes the socket if initialized and resets the handle.

methods.name: ClientSocketHandle::GetLoadState
methods.description: Returns the current load state of the socket handle.

methods.name: ClientSocketHandle::IsPoolStalled
methods.description: Checks if the socket pool is stalled.

methods.name: ClientSocketHandle::AddHigherLayeredPool
methods.description: Adds a higher-layered pool to the handle.

methods.name: ClientSocketHandle::RemoveHigherLayeredPool
methods.description: Removes a higher-layered pool from the handle.

methods.name: ClientSocketHandle::CloseIdleSocketsInGroup
methods.description: Closes idle sockets in the specified group.

methods.name: ClientSocketHandle::GetLoadTimingInfo
methods.description: Retrieves load timing information for the socket.

methods.name: ClientSocketHandle::SetSocket
methods.description: Assigns a socket to the handle.

methods.name: ClientSocketHandle::SetAdditionalErrorState
methods.description: Sets error-related information based on a connect job.

methods.name: ClientSocketHandle::PassSocket
methods.description: Transfers ownership of the socket out of the handle.

methods.name: ClientSocketHandle::OnIOComplete
methods.description: Callback invoked upon I/O completion, handling the result.

methods.name: ClientSocketHandle::HandleInitCompletion
methods.description: Handles the completion of socket initialization, updating state and logging.

methods.name: ClientSocketHandle::ResetInternal
methods.description: Performs internal reset operations, releasing sockets and resetting state.
